name: Accelerate
desc: Increases the speed of projectile spells.

name: Amplify
desc: Additively increases the power of most spell effects. Can increase the harvest level of Break and increases the damage of spells.
desc_fr: Augmente la puissance de l'effet précédent.

name: Animate Block
desc: Animates a block to fight for you. The animated block will convert to a falling block when it dies. Costs a large amount of mana, but does not grant Summoning Sickness

name: AOE
desc: Spells will affect a larger area around a targeted block.

name: Blink
desc: Teleports the caster to a location. If an entity is hit and the caster is holding a Warp Scroll in the offhand, the entity will be warped to the location on the Warp Scroll. When used on Self, the caster blinks forward. Spell Turrets and Runes can warp entities using Warp Scrolls from adjacent inventories without consuming the scroll.

name: Bounce
desc: Gives players the Bounce effect, causing them to bounce upwards upon falling. Amplification of Bounce will preserve additional forward facing motion per bounce.

name: Break
desc: A spell you start with. Breaks blocks of an average hardness. Can be amplified to increase the harvest level. Sensitive will simulate breaking blocks with Shears instead of a pickaxe.

name: Cold Snap
desc: Snares and causes a burst of damage to an entity that is afflicted by slowness, freezing, or is wet. Nearby enemies that are not afflicted by Slow will be slowed. Nearby Enemies afflicted by Slow or wetness will also be hit by Cold Snap. Can be augmented using Amplify, Extend Time, and AOE.

name: Conjure Water
desc: Places water at a location or extinguishes entities on fire.

name: Craft
desc: Opens the crafting menu.

name: Crush
desc: Turns stone into gravel, and gravel into sand. Will also crush flowers into bonus dye. Need Sensitive to work on items. For full recipe support, see JEI. Will also harm entities and deals bonus damage to entities that are swimming.

name: Cut
desc: Simulates using shears on entities and blocks, or damages non-shearable entities for a small amount. Amplify will simulate using an Axe instead of Shears. For simulating breaking with shears, see Break and Sensitive. Costs nothing.

name: Dampen
desc: Decreases the power of most spells.

name: Decelerate
desc: Decreases the speed of projectile spells.

name: Delay
desc: Delays the resolution of effects placed to the right of this spell for a few moments. The delay may be increased with the Extend Time augment, or decreased with Duration Down.

name: Dispel
desc: Removes any potion effects on the target. When used on a witch at half health, the witch will vanish in return for a Wixie shard. Will also dispel tamed summons back into their charm.
desc_fr: Retire les effets de la cible.

name: Duration Down
desc: Reduces the duration of spells like potion effects, delay, redstone signal, and others.

name: Access Ender Inventory
desc: Opens your personal ender chest inventory from anywhere.

name: Evaporate
desc: Deletes fluids in an area. Can be expanded with AOE.

name: Exchange
desc: When used on blocks, exchanges the blocks in the players hotbar for the blocks hit as if they were mined with silk touch. Can be augmented with AOE, and Amplify is required for swapping blocks of higher hardness. When used on entities, the locations of the caster and the entity hit are swapped.

name: Explosion
desc: Causes an explosion at the location. Amplify increases the damage and size by a small amount, while AOE will increase the size of the explosion by a large amount, but not damage.

name: Extend Time
desc: Extends the time that spells last, including buffs, fangs, and summons

name: Extract
desc: Applies a silk-touch effect to Break and causes Explosion to not destroy blocks that drop. Cannot be combined with Fortune.

name: Fangs
desc: Summons Evoker Fangs in the direction where the spell was targeted. Using fangs on your self will spawn them in an area around you.

name: Fell
desc: Harvests entire trees, mushrooms, cactus, and other vegetation. Can be amplified with Amplify to break materials of higher hardness. AOE will increase the number of blocks that may be broken at one time.

name: Firework
desc: Creates a firework at the location or entity. Amplify will add Firework Stars, while Extend Time will add additional flight time. If a firework exists in the casters inventory, the created firework will mimic the held one. Spell Turrets with Touch will create fireworks as if they were dispensed.

name: Flare
desc: When used on entities that are on fire, Flare causes a burst of damage and will spread fire and deal damage to other nearby entities. Does significantly more damage than Harm. Can be augmented with Extend Time, Amplify, and AOE.

name: Luck
desc: Increases the drop chance from mobs killed by Damage and blocks that are destroyed by Break. Cannot be combined with Extract.

name: Freeze
desc: Freezes water or lava in a small area or slows a target for a short time. Freeze on Ice will turn it into Packed Ice, and Packed Ice into Blue Ice. Sensitive will turn water into Frosted Ice and will vanish after a short time.

name: Glide
desc: Grants the Glide effect, allowing the wearer to fly as if they were wearing an Elytra.

name: Gravity
desc: Causes blocks and entities to fall. When augmented with Extend Time, players will have their flight disabled and will obtain the Gravity effect. While afflicted with Gravity, entities will rapidly fall and take double falling damage.

name: Grow
desc: Causes plants to accelerate in growth as if they were bonemealed.

name: Knockback
desc: Knocks a target or block away a short distance from the caster. Sensitive will stop this spell from launching blocks.

name: Harm
desc: A spell you start with. Damages a target. May be increased by Amplify, or applies the Poison debuff when using Extend Time. Note, multiple Harms without a delay will not apply due to invincibility on hit.
desc_fr: Inflige des dégâts (augmenté par Amplifier ; poison avec Prolonger).

name: Harvest
desc: When used on grown crops, this spell will obtain the fully grown product without destroying the plant.

name: Heal
desc: Heals a small amount of health and consumes hunger from the caster. When used on Undead, the spell will deal an equal amount of magic damage.

name: Hex
desc: Applies the Hex effect. Hex increases any damage taken by a small amount while the user is afflicted by poison, wither, or fire. Additionally, Hex cuts the rate of Mana Regeneration and healing in half.
desc_fr: Inflige des dégâts supplémentaires aux cibles affligées.

name: Ignite
desc: Sets blocks and mobs on fire for a short time. Sensitive will stop this spell from igniting blocks.

name: Infuse
desc: Infuses a target with a potion or flask from your inventory. If augmented with AOE, a splash potion will spawn at the location. If augmented with Extend Time, a lingering potion will spawn at the location. Caster blocks may pull from adjacent Potion Jars to cast infuse.

name: Intangible
desc: Causes blocks to temporarily turn into air. Can be modified with Amplify for blocks of higher hardness, AOE, Duration Down, and Extend Time.

name: Interact
desc: Interacts with blocks or entities as it were a player. Useful for reaching levers, chests, or animals. Sensitive will use your off-hand item on the block or entity.

name: Invisibility
desc: Causes the target to turn invisible for a short time.

name: Launch
desc: Launches an entity or block into the air. Can be used for large jumps, yeeting mobs in the sky or for scaling mountains! Sensitive will stop this spell from launching blocks.

name: Leap
desc: Launches the target in the direction they are looking. Amplification will increase the distance moved.

name: Conjure Magelight
desc: If cast on a block, a permanent light source is created. May be amplified up to Glowstone brightness, or Dampened for a lower light level. When cast on yourself, you will receive night vision. When cast on other entities, they will receive Night Vision and Glowing.

name: Lightning
desc: Summons a lightning bolt at the location. Entities struck will be given the Shocked effect. Shocked causes all additional lightning damage to deal bonus damage, and increases the level of Shocked up to III. Lightning also deals bonus damage to entities that are wet or wearing RF powered items. Can be augmented with Amplify, Dampen, and Extend Time.

name: Linger
desc: Creates a lingering field that applies spells on nearby entities for a short time. Applying Sensitive will make this spell target blocks instead. AOE will expand the effective range, Accelerate will cast spells faster, Dampen will ignore gravity, and Extend Time will increase the duration.

name: Name
desc: Names an entity after the set Spell Name. Targeting a block will name nearby entities or name inventory blocks directly if possible. Targeting with Self will name the held offhand item. Can be overridden with a name tag in the hotbar.

name: Orbit
desc: Summons three orbiting projectiles around the caster that will cast a spell on any entities it may hit. Additional projectiles, their speed, radius, and duration may be augmented. Sensitive will cause Orbit to hit blocks.
desc_fr: Fait orbiter le sort autour de toi.

name: Conjure Mageblock
desc: Creates a temporary block that will disappear after a short time. Amplify will cause the block to be permanent. Dispelling this block will destroy it instantly.

name: Item Pickup
desc: Picks up nearby items in a medium radius where this spell is activated. The range may be expanded with AOE.

name: Pierce
desc: When applied to the Projectile spell, projectiles may continue through their path an additional time after hitting a mob or block. Causes certain effects to also target the block behind them, like Break. Combines with AOE to provide depth.

name: Place Block
desc: Places blocks from the casters inventory. If a player is casting this, this spell will place blocks from the hot bar first.

name: Projectile
desc: A spell you start with. Summons a projectile that applies spell effects when this projectile hits a target or block. Sensitive will allow Projectiles to break plants or other materials that do not block motion.

name: Pull
desc: Pulls the target closer to the caster. When used on blocks, they become falling blocks with motion towards the side of the block that was hit. Sensitive will stop this spell from pulling blocks.

name: Randomize
desc: Randomize the behavior of some glyphs. If used with spells like Place Block and Exchange, it will randomize the block that is placed between the blocks in your hotbar.

name: Redstone Signal
desc: Places a temporary block of redstone with configurable power and duration. Augment with Sensitive to set the target block as a power source for itself and surrounding blocks. Dampen and Amplify will adjust the power from the base value of 10.

name: Rotate
desc: Rotates a block or an entity clockwise. If augmented with sensitive it will change the axis of the block (if possible) or force the entity to turn their look. Dampen will rotate counter-clockwise.

name: Rune
desc: Places a rune on the ground that will cast the spell on targets that touch the rune. Unlike runes placed by Runic Chalk, these runes are temporary and cannot be recharged. When using Item Pickup, items are deposited into adjacent inventories. Sensitive will cause the rune to use the Owner's inventory for pickup and usage instead. Players with Magic Find will be able to read spells inscribed on runes.
desc_fr: Pose le sort sur une rune au sol.

name: Self
desc: A spell you start with. Applies spells on the caster.

name: Sense Magic
desc: Applies Magic Find to the target, causing magical mobs to glow within 75 blocks of them. Magic Find also reveals spells on Runes.

name: Sensitive
desc: Causes forms to target blocks they normally cannot target. Projectile and Orbit will target grass, and Touch will target fluids and air. Changes targeting rules of certain effects.
desc_fr: Le projectile touche aussi les blocs sensibles.

name: Slowfall
desc: Applies the Slow Fall buff.

name: Smelt
desc: Smelts blocks and items in the world. AOE will increase the number of items and radius of blocks that can be smelted at once, while Amplify will allow Smelt to work on blocks of higher hardness.

name: Snare
desc: Stops entities from moving and jumping. Extend Time will increase the duration of this effect. Snaring a block created from the Focus of Block Shaping will cause it to attempt to place itself immediately.

name: Split
desc: Causes multiple projectiles to be cast at once. Each projectile applies a set of effects.

name: Summon Decoy
desc: Summons a decoy of yourself. Upon summoning, the decoy will attract any nearby mobs to attack it.

name: Summon Steed
desc: Summons a saddled horse that will vanish after a few minutes. AOE will increase the amount summoned, while Extend Time will increase the duration of the summon. Applies Summoning Sickness to the caster, and cannot be cast while afflicted by this Sickness.

name: Summon Undead
desc: Summons a number of Skeleton allies that will attack nearby hostile enemies. These Skeletons will last a short time until they begin to take damage, but time may be extended with the Extend Time augment.  Additionally, their summoned weapons are changed using augments, use Amplify to give it a better sword, or Pierce to give it a bow.  Adding Split after the effect will add to the number of summoned skeletons.

name: Summon Vex
desc: Summons three Vex allies that will attack nearby hostile enemies. These Vex will last a short time until they begin to take damage, but time may be extended with the Extend Time augment.

name: Summon Wolves
desc: Summons two wolves that will fight with you. Extend Time will increase the amount of time on the summons. Applies Summoning Sickness to the caster, preventing other summoning magic.

name: Toss
desc: Causes the caster to place an item from their inventory to a location. If this glyph is used on an inventory, the item will attempt to be inserted into it.

name: Touch
desc: Applies spells at the block or entity that is targeted.
desc_fr: Applique le sort au bloc/créature touché.

name: Underfoot
desc: Targets the spell on the block beneath the player.
desc_fr: Applique le sort sous tes pieds.

name: Wall
desc: Creates a lingering wall that applies spells on nearby entities for a short time. Applying Sensitive will make this spell target blocks instead. AOE will expand the effective range, Accelerate will cast spells faster, Dampen will ignore gravity, and Extend Time will increase the duration.

name: Wind Shear
desc: Deals damage to targets in the air, with an increasing amount based on how high the target is off the ground, up to 10 blocks. Targets on the ground take no damage.

name: Wither
desc: Applies the Wither debuff.
